newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak bank raises prime rate - agency.
newsitem.headline: Slovak bank raises prime rate - agency.

text.p: Investicna a Rozvojova Banka (IRB) a.s., Slovakia's third largest commercial bank, has raised its prime lending rate to 15.0 percent from 13.5 percent, the official news agency TASR said on Monday.
The prime rate hike, the IRB's second in the past month, took effect February 20, after a full-percentage point rise earlier. IRB officials were not immediately available for further comment.
It added that the bank was also raising non-prime interest rates on credits of over three months by 100 basis points.
The report did not include any comment on the moves.
Rates on the money market currently range between 13.4 percent on overnights to 17.70 percent on six-month terms. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 42-7-521-8402
